interpretationNotes: Published capabilities are vendor descriptions, not claimed observations of a selected customer account.
All proposed desk procedures and data fields are authored implementation criteria.
Pricing page broadly labels location counts, while commercial pages also use location for contract sites; confirm the actual account meaning before promising capacity.
The privacy summary simplifies hosting to US servers; the detailed section identifies application processing in Germany and storage/authentication in US East. Use the detailed distinction.
The public API's customer-create prose says source import while its example response says widget; avoid assuming that field's returned value.
No competitor capability comparison is inferred from BroomDesk's comparison pages.
